summary: While spirit-channeling Hood Eugen, Klein encounters the image of a vast cross with an upside-down figure and connects the experience to the True Creator and Lanevus's Aurora Order-linked scheme.

Klein and the Tingen Nighthawks confront Megose and the gestating spawn produced by Lanevus's ritual to the True Creator, turning Klein's indirect investigation into a lethal confrontation with the deity's descent plan.

When Lovia recites the True Creator's honorific name in the Giant King's Court expedition, Klein senses a familiar gaze interfering with his observation from above the gray fog and identifies the watcher as the True Creator.

knownIdentity: True Creator = ancient sun god evil spirit after Sasrir personality recovery
summary: Klein learns that the True Creator is equivalent to the ancient sun god's evil-spirit side after retrieving Sasrir's personality, while Adam explains that he will only be complete after fusing with 'True.'

knownIdentity: Celestial Worthy of Heaven and Earth for Blessings / suspected former Sefirah Castle owner
summary: At the barrier associated with the vanished Western Continent, Klein hears the Celestial Worthy's honorific name in the real world and reconnects it to the luck-enhancement ritual that caused his transmigration and to Sefirah Castle's former owner.

knownIdentity: Celestial Worthy = former Lord of the Mysteries / great ruler above the spirit world
summary: The Seven Lights identify the Celestial Worthy as the former Lord of the Mysteries, King of Space-Time, Beacon of Destiny, Embodiment of Sefirah Castle, and Dominator of the Spirit World. Klein then realizes this is the mental imprint already awakening within him.

After Klein becomes an Attendant of Mysteries and absorbs Zaratul's characteristic, the Celestial Worthy's awakening becomes faster and more intense. Klein uses Zaratul's remnant mental imprint and his anchors to maintain a fragile balance.

knownIdentity: Celestial Worthy awakening in Klein and Amon
summary: During the divine duel for Sefirah Castle, Klein recognizes that the conflict has another participant: the Celestial Worthy's will inside both contenders, which either side can strengthen to destabilize the other.

knownIdentity: former Lord of the Mysteries as last-resort successor
summary: Klein deliberately stops resisting the former Lord of the Mysteries' will and challenges Amon to see who can tolerate a deeper awakening. His willingness to risk being replaced becomes the decisive pressure in the duel.

After Amon's defeat, the Celestial Worthy's will rapidly awakens inside Klein and even prevents him from rejecting the converging Error and Door characteristics, leaving him unable to simply escape through death and resurrection.

knownIdentity: Celestial Worthy and most of Klein's consciousness put into slumber
summary: With Evernight's help, the Celestial Worthy's will and most of Klein's consciousness enter temporary eternal slumber. Klein is told that the lasting solution is to enter a deeper sleep and resist and fuse with the former Lord of the Mysteries in the dream.

knownIdentity: ongoing Klein vs Celestial Worthy dream struggle
summary: Klein tells the Tarot Club that The Fool and The World will enter slumber, turning the unresolved struggle with the Celestial Worthy into the central post-Book-1 condition rather than a completed victory.
